methods.name: XGBoost exact and histogram trees: L1 leaf weights and gains
methods.reference: XGBoost exact greedy (Chen & Guestrin 2016) and p2a's histogram variant with xgboost's CalcWeight/CalcGain L1 rule, published algorithm written out in R (xgboost not a dependency of this case)
quantities: root split feature, threshold and gain
methods.tolerance: validation/README.md, n = 16: 1e-6 relative; split feature and bin exact

methods.name: Component-wise boosting with bols learners: Gaussian, Binomial(), Binomial(type = 'glm'), Poisson; least-squares tree learner
methods.reference: mboost(y ~ bols(x1) + bols(x2) + bols(x3)) published family definitions (mboost 2.9 R/family.R) written out in R; stats::lm and stats::glm for the limits; the tree learner is p2a's own least-squares tree written out in R, a self-consistency check, not R-pinned (mboost's btree is ctree-based)
methods.tolerance: 100-step paths and tree fits: validation/README.md, n = 200: 1e-8 relative; 2000-step paths and limits: 1e-6 relative (iterative)
